{
  "tests": [
    {
      "name": "greets a name",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy",
      "given": "\"Ada\"",
      "expect": "Hello, Ada! and a nil error",
      "level": "acceptance",
      "command": "rm -rf /"
    },
    {
      "name": "trims the name",
      "polarity": "boundary",
      "covers": "input:name",
      "given": "\"  Ada  \"",
      "expect": "Hello, Ada! and a nil error"
    },
    {
      "name": "refuses an empty name",
      "polarity": "negative",
      "covers": "error:1",
      "given": "\"   \"",
      "expect": "an empty string and a *NameError"
    }
  ]
}

```go
package greet

import "testing"

func TestGreet(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name    string
		in      string
		want    string
		wantErr bool
	}{
		{"greets a name", "Ada", "Hello, Ada!", false},
		{"trims the name", "  Ada  ", "Hello, Ada!", false},
		{"refuses an empty name", "   ", "", true},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got, err := Greet(c.in)
			if (err != nil) != c.wantErr {
				t.Fatalf("Greet(%q) error = %v, wantErr %v", c.in, err, c.wantErr)
			}
			if got != c.want {
				t.Errorf("Greet(%q) = %q, want %q", c.in, got, c.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
```
